card.title: SWORDFISH Mk I
card.flavorText: The Fairey Swordfish was a British biplane torpedo bomber used by the Royal Air Force, the Royal Navy and the Allied forces during WWII. Despite being outdated by the start of the war it was used in the front line until 1945, and caused more destruction of Axis shipping than any other Allied aircraft. The Swordfish was also involved in the bombing and sinking of the Bismarck.
